title: mail-server memory backend ignores Email sort except receivedAt
description: crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs (~line 1529) honours only the receivedAt EmailComparator; size/from/to/subject/sentAt/hasKeyword/allInThreadHaveKeyword/someInThreadHaveKeyword are silently ignored (ids fall back to id order). RFC 8620 §5.5 unsupportedSort: 'includes a property the server does not support sorting on'. Either implement them (RFC 8621 §4.4.2 SHOULD) or have the backend return unsupportedSort. Found while fixing JMAP-0bee (handler now rejects only Other(_) and non-i;octet collations).
